description: Manage Linode Public Cloud instances and optionally wait for it to be ‘running’.

parameters.name: additional_disks
parameters.description: List of dictionaries for creating additional disks that are added to the Linode configuration settings. Dictionary takes Size, Label, Type. Size is in MB.

parameters.name: alert_bwin_enabled
parameters.description: Set status of bandwidth in alerts. Choices: false true

parameters.name: alert_bwin_threshold
parameters.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth in alerts.

parameters.name: alert_bwout_enabled
parameters.description: Set status of bandwidth out alerts. Choices: false true

parameters.name: alert_bwout_threshold
parameters.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth out alerts.

parameters.name: alert_bwquota_enabled
parameters.description: Set status of bandwidth quota alerts as percentage of network transfer quota. Choices: false true

parameters.name: alert_bwquota_threshold
parameters.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth quota alerts.

parameters.name: alert_cpu_enabled
parameters.description: Set status of receiving CPU usage alerts. Choices: false true

parameters.name: alert_cpu_threshold
parameters.description: Set percentage threshold for receiving CPU usage alerts. Each CPU core adds 100% to total.

parameters.name: alert_diskio_enabled
parameters.description: Set status of receiving disk IO alerts. Choices: false true

parameters.name: alert_diskio_threshold
parameters.description: Set threshold for average IO ops/sec over 2 hour period.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Linode API key. LINODE_API_KEY environment variable can be used instead.

parameters.name: backupweeklyday
parameters.description: Day of the week to take backups.

parameters.name: backupwindow
parameters.description: The time window in which backups are taken.

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: Datacenter to create an instance in (Linode Datacenter).

parameters.name: displaygroup
parameters.description: Add the instance to a Display Group in Linode Manager. Default: ""

parameters.name: distribution
parameters.description: Distribution to use for the instance (Linode Distribution).

parameters.name: kernel_id
parameters.description: Kernel to use for the instance (Linode Kernel).

parameters.name: linode_id
parameters.description: Unique ID of a Linode server. This value is read-only in the sense that if you specify it on creation of a Linode it is not used. The Linode API generates these IDs and we can those generated value here to reference a Linode more specifically. This is useful for idempotency.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name to give the instance (alphanumeric, dashes, underscore). To keep sanity on the Linode Web Console, name is prepended with LinodeID-.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Root password to apply to a new server (auto generated if missing).

parameters.name: payment_term
parameters.description: Payment term to use for the instance (payment term in months). Choices: 1 ← (default) 12 24

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: Plan to use for the instance (Linode plan).

parameters.name: private_ip
parameters.description: Add private IPv4 address when Linode is created. Default is false. Choices: false true

parameters.name: ssh_pub_key
parameters.description: SSH public key applied to root user.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the resource. Choices: "absent" "active" "deleted" "present" ← (default) "restarted" "started" "stopped"

parameters.name: swap
parameters.description: Swap size in MB. Default: 512

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to be in state running before returning. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds. Default: 300

parameters.name: watchdog
parameters.description: Set status of Lassie watchdog. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a new Linode
  community.general.linode:
    name: linode-test1
    plan: 1
    datacenter: 7
    distribution: 129
    state: present
  register: linode_creation

- name: Create a server with a private IP Address
  community.general.linode:
    module: linode
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    plan: 1
    datacenter: 2
    distribution: 99
    password: 'superSecureRootPassword'
    private_ip: true
    ssh_pub_key: 'ssh-rsa qwerty'
    swap: 768
    wait: true
    wait_timeout: 600
    state: present
  delegate_to: localhost
  register: linode_creation

- name: Fully configure new server
  community.general.linode:
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    plan: 4
    datacenter: 2
    distribution: 99
    kernel_id: 138
    password: 'superSecureRootPassword'
    private_ip: true
    ssh_pub_key: 'ssh-rsa qwerty'
    swap: 768
    wait: true
    wait_timeout: 600
    state: present
    alert_bwquota_enabled: true
    alert_bwquota_threshold: 80
    alert_bwin_enabled: true
    alert_bwin_threshold: 10
    alert_cpu_enabled: true
    alert_cpu_threshold: 210
    alert_bwout_enabled: true
    alert_bwout_threshold: 10
    alert_diskio_enabled: true
    alert_diskio_threshold: 10000
    backupweeklyday: 1
    backupwindow: 2
    displaygroup: 'test'
    additional_disks:
      - {Label: 'disk1', Size: 2500, Type: 'raw'}
      - {Label: 'newdisk', Size: 2000}
    watchdog: true
  delegate_to: localhost
  register: linode_creation

- name: Ensure a running server (create if missing)
  community.general.linode:
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    plan: 1
    datacenter: 2
    distribution: 99
    password: 'superSecureRootPassword'
    ssh_pub_key: 'ssh-rsa qwerty'
    swap: 768
    wait: true
    wait_timeout: 600
    state: present
  delegate_to: localhost
  register: linode_creation

- name: Delete a server
  community.general.linode:
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    linode_id: "{{ linode_creation.instance.id }}"
    state: absent
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Stop a server
  community.general.linode:
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    linode_id: "{{ linode_creation.instance.id }}"
    state: stopped
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Reboot a server
  community.general.linode:
    api_key: 'longStringFromLinodeApi'
    name: linode-test1
    linode_id: "{{ linode_creation.instance.id }}"
    state: restarted
  delegate_to: localhost
